title: Beneficiary360Request
description: Request payload for the Beneficiary-360 API. Resolves a single beneficiary's Foundational ID into a consolidated view across all Registries, PBMS Programs, Disbursements, and G2P-Bridge processing status, bounded by a coarse-grained lookback timeframe.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. Use the published context URL or the literal document.

foundationalId.description: The beneficiary's Foundational ID as registered in Registry-Platform (reg:foundationalId, e.g. G2PPerson/G2PProgramRegister.foundational_id). This is the single cross-system key used to fan out lookups to every connected Registry.

timeframe.description: How far back to traverse historical records (registry record history, enrolment cycles, disbursement cycles) in each source system. Concrete windows are resolved server-side per source system (e.g. Short=90d, Medium=1y, Long=all-time) and are echoed back in meta.resolvedTimeframe.

asOfDate.description: Optional anchor date the timeframe is computed backward from. Defaults to the request's processing date (today) if omitted.

sections.description: Optional filter to request only a subset of the response sections. Omit to receive all sections.

registryFilter.description: Optional allow-list of registry codes to restrict the fan-out (e.g. only query ["FARMER_REGISTRY", "DISABILITY_REGISTRY"]). Omit to query every registry known to the Beneficiary-360 registry catalog.

correlationId.description: Optional client-supplied trace/correlation identifier, echoed back in the response meta block.
